new_doc_query.query: what is the interest rate on house loan
new_doc_query.response:
You can find your answer below:
Home loan interest rates start at 8.40% per annum for salaried individuals with a credit score of 750 or above. The maximum loan repayment tenure offered is 30 years.
If your loan amount is more than 50000 INR up to 250000 INR inclusively, then the interest rate would be 1.1% monthly. If your loan amount is between 250001 INR and 800000 INR , the interest rate would be 1% monthly.
If your loan amount is more than 800000 INR, the interest rate would be 0.92% monthly.
